next.reason: 1985: format 2 serves random access mode, and dynamic access mode when records are retrieved randomly. 2023: without an explicit or implied NEXT or PREVIOUS 'the read is a random read and the rules for format 2 apply' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR19); random mode bars NEXT, PREVIOUS, AT END and the like (§2023:14.9.30.3 SR6); in dynamic mode NEXT is implied only with ADVANCING, AT END or NOT AT END (§2023:14.9.30.3 SR9), which format 2 never carried. The same READs are random under both.
